description.value: Sarpino's Pizzeria is a gourmet pizza franchise in downtown Victoria, serving hand-made dough pizzas with a wide range of toppings alongside pasta, wings, salads, and desserts. The location operates as a locally owned and operated franchisee and offers both pickup and delivery. Touring cyclists passing through Victoria's downtown core will find a filling, quick meal option with vegetarian and plant-based choices on the menu.
